notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Small patch with some fixes and general improvements. More significant changes on their way when I finish my exams!

[h1] Fixes	[/h1]
- Fixed mouse sensitivity locking to 0 in some cases
- Alien navigation is less moronic

[h1] General    [/h1]
- Guns no longer despawn
- Grubbs have colour variations and much more violent deaths
- Lighting improvements for some floors
- Spawncounts are capped for some levels

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31796675/c3d9573c756b4d35254091b3a641ec7c6e6061b6.png[/img]
